name: marc-mods
description: Marc's own Claude Code mods, read straight from this folder so upstream updates never overwrite them.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: hellosverre's skins 0.5.3 with Marc's customizations (see skins-customizations.patch): dials-only usage band, red Compact, Clawd with fifteen wait scenes.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: johnnyvizz's savvy-progress 1.2.0 (claude-kit 272a877) with side-session cost/tokens/time, click-to-open rows, and a build jobs view beside the agents.

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: johnnyvizz's savvy-flow 1.2.0 (claude-kit 272a877) with build jobs and a memo-first step for mega builds.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Anthropic's Claude Code DevRel example mod (Apache-2.0, unchanged): holds risky shell commands like rm -rf, git reset --hard and force push, shows what they'd change, with Proceed and Cancel.
